name: AQLS (Advanced Quantum Light Sources)
description: AQLS (Advanced Quantum Light Sources) is a Berlin quantum photonics company founded in 2023 by three quantum optics researchers. It builds photon-pair sources based on spontaneous parametric down-conversion (SPDC), including its PPS-DG product, for quantum communication, quantum sensing, metrology and photonic quantum computing research.

products.name: PPS-DG photon-pair source
products.description: SPDC-based entangled photon-pair source for quantum optics research, metrology and photonic quantum information processing
